NURS 180.title: Stress and Strategies to Promote Well Being
NURS 180.description: Introduction to foundational knowledge related to stress, stressors, resilience, social support, and strategies to foster physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual health. Open to all students interested in learning about managing and navigating the stressors of student life.

NURS 270.title: Diverse Perspectives on Aging
NURS 270.description: Examines aging experience from interdisciplinary, equity, diversity, inclusion and Indigeneity (EDI-I) (race, sex, gender, disability), and systems perspectives. Topics include older adult health and illness, age friendly communities, ageism and stigma, and end of life issues.

NURS 280.title: Human Sexual Health
NURS 280.description: Beliefs, behaviours, and expressions of human sexuality and the link to health for students from any program. How sexuality is discussed and practiced from various perspectives, and strategies to promote healthy sexual expression and sexual health.

NURS 290.title: Health Impacts of Climate Change
NURS 290.description: Human health impacts of the current and projected environmental crisis; study of key concepts and ideas to prepare for the future to promote wellbeing of individuals, communities and populations.

NURS 300.title: Theoretical and Professional Foundations for Nursing Practice
NURS 300.description: Introduction to knowledge fundamental to the discipline and practice of nursing.

NURS 301.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: Primary Health Care
NURS 301.description: Analysis and application of theories, concepts, evidence and competencies guiding professional nursing practice in the context of primary health care.
NURS 301.prerequisiteText: Five of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 303.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: People Living with Mental Health Challenges and Their Families
NURS 303.description: Theory informing a life course perspective on nursing practice with people living with mental health challenges and their families is introduced.
NURS 303.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 310.title: Basic Principles of Pharmacology for Nursing Practice
NURS 310.description: Basic principles of pharmacology and the basic structure and function of each body system will be explored to demonstrate how drug interactions occur within systems.

NURS 321.title: Foundational Skills and Competencies for Clinical Practice I
NURS 321.description: Skills and competencies for clinical practice using a variety of modalities and learning activities.
NURS 321.corequisiteText: All of NURS_V300, NURS_V310, NURS_V330, NURS_V352, NURS_V 360

NURS 322.title: Foundational Skills and Competencies for Clinical Practice II
NURS 322.description: Clinical practice through a variety of modalities and learning activities in the laboratory environment.
NURS 322.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 323.title: Foundational Skills and Competencies for Clinical Practice III
NURS 323.description: Skills and competencies for clinical practice across the lifespan and health care continuum through a variety of modalities and learning activities.
NURS 323.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 330.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: Adults/Older Adults and their Families
NURS 330.description: Fundamental theories, concepts, evidence, and competencies pertaining to nursing practice with adults/older adults and their families.
NURS 330.corequisiteText: All of NURS 300, NURS 310, NURS 321, NURS 352, NURS 360

NURS 331.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: Adults/Older Adults Experiencing Acute Health Challenges and Their Families
NURS 331.description: Consolidation of fundamental theories, concepts, evidence, and competencies pertaining to acute care nursing practice with adults/older adults and their families.
NURS 331.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 344.title: Critical Inquiry and Leadership Synthesis
NURS 344.description: Evidence is examined and synthesized to understand and identify theoretical insights to address a leadership challenge in professional practice.
NURS 344.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 350, NURS_V 351, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 345.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: Childbearing Individuals and their Families
NURS 345.description: Analysis and application of theories, concepts, evidence and competencies guiding professional nursing practice with childbearing individuals and families during the transition to parenthood in a variety of practice settings and contexts.
NURS 345.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 346.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: Infants, Children, Youth and their Families
NURS 346.description: Analysis and application of theories, concepts, evidence and competencies guiding professional nursing practice with infants, children, youth and their families in a variety of practice settings and contexts.
NURS 346.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 350.title: Critical Inquiry and Research in Health Care Practice
NURS 350.description: The significance of critical inquiry and research in nursing and health care, and the fundamental concepts and processes pertaining to scientific inquiry, evidence-based practice, and research utilization in nursing. Students who take NURS_V 350 cannot earn credit for NURS_V 305, NURS_V 339 or NURS_V 342. This course is eligible for Cr/F for 19W2 only.
NURS 350.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 351.title: Leadership, Policy, and Informatics
NURS 351.description: The enactment of nursing leadership and policy within different health sectors and jurisdictions and the relevance and application of informatics competencies to the delivery of nursing care.
NURS 351.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 352.title: Relational and Ethical Nursing Practice
NURS 352.description: Relational theoretical underpinnings of nursing practice and healthcare ethics are critically examined.
NURS 352.corequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 360

NURS 353.title: Promoting the Health of Indigenous People
NURS 353.description: Foundations to contribute to supporting and providing high quality, ethical, respectful and culturally safe health care in partnership with Indigenous people in Canada and around the globe.
NURS 353.prerequisiteText: All of NURS 300, NURS 310, NURS 321, NURS 330, NURS 352, NURS 360

NURS 354.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: Complexities in Seniors Care
NURS 354.description: Research and clinical practice innovations in the care of Seniors and their families (e.g., philosophies of care; age-friendly initiatives) and provide strategies for improving their health through the purposeful integration of such practices in clinical settings.
NURS 354.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 360.title: Nursing Practice with Adults/Older Adults and their Families
NURS 360.description: Nursing practice to integrate and consolidate professional nursing knowledge, skills, and competencies in care of adults/older adults with stable/expected health care challenges and their families. Practice learning may occur in settings like community, home, inpatient, clinics and/or simulated learning.
NURS 360.corequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352

NURS 361.title: Nursing Practice with Adults/Older Adults Experiencing Acute Health Challenges and their Families
NURS 361.description: Clinical practice to integrate and consolidate professional nursing knowledge, skills and competencies in the care of adults/older adults experiencing acute health challenges and their families. Practice learning may occur in settings like community, home, inpatient, clinics and/or simulated learning.
NURS 361.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 362.title: Nursing Practice in Primary Health Care Contexts
NURS 362.description: Clinical practice to integrate and consolidate professional nursing knowledge, skills and competencies in the context of primary health care.
NURS 362.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 363.title: Nursing Practice with People Living with Mental Health Challenges and Their Families
NURS 363.description: Students will apply theory and concepts from a life course perspective in provision of nursing care to persons living with mental health challenges and their families.
NURS 363.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 365.title: Nursing Practice with Childbearing Individuals and Families
NURS 365.description: Clinical practice to integrate and consolidate professional nursing knowledge, skills and competencies in the care of childbearing individuals, infants, and their families.
NURS 365.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360

NURS 366.title: Nursing Practice with Infants, Children, Youth and their Families: Practicum
NURS 366.description: Nursing practice to integrate and consolidate professional nursing knowledge, skills and competencies in the care of infants, children, youth and their families.
NURS 366.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352

NURS 401.title: Foundational Skills and Competencies for Clinical Practice IV
NURS 401.description: Students are prepared with the skills and competencies for clinical practice in simulated acute and community settings through a variety of modalities and learning activities.
NURS 401.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 322, NURS_V 323, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 360
NURS 401.corequisiteText: Either (a) all of NURS_V 345, NURS_V 365, NURS_V 346, NURS_V 366 or (b) all of NURS_V 303, NURS_V 363, NURS_V 301, NURS_V 362

NURS 402.title: Foundational Skills and Competencies for Clinical Practice V
NURS 402.description: Students are guided to consolidate skills and competencies for clinical practice through a variety of modalities and learning activities.
NURS 402.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 322, NURS_V 323, NURS_V 350, NURS_V 351, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 353, NURS_V 360, NURS_V 361, NURS_V 362, NURS_V 363, NURS_V 365, NURS_V 366, NURS_V 401

NURS 410.title: Supplemental Guided Study
NURS 410.description: Supplemental guided study to integrate and consolidate professional nursing knowledge, skills and competencies. For Bachelor of Science Nursing students only. Pass/Fail.

NURS 427.title: Consolidated Practice Experience
NURS 427.description: Nursing practice to consolidate nursing knowledge, theory, evidence, and practice, and facilitate the transition to professional practice.

NURS 430.title: Theoretical Perspectives in Nursing: Special Topics in Complex and Urgent Health Challenges across Settings/Populations
NURS 430.description: Consolidation of fundamental theories, concepts, evidence, and competencies pertaining to nursing practice across the life-span and care context.
NURS 430.prerequisiteText: All of NURS_V 300, NURS_V 301, NURS_V 303, NURS_V 310, NURS_V 321, NURS_V 322, NURS_V 323, NURS_V 330, NURS_V 331, NURS_V 345, NURS_V 346, NURS_V 350, NURS_V 351, NURS_V 352, NURS_V 353, NURS_V 354, NURS_V 360, NURS_V 361, NURS_V 362, NURS_V 363, NURS_V 365, NURS_V 366, NURS_V 401

NURS 510.title: Advanced Health Assessment Across the Life Span

NURS 520.title: Administrative Leadership in Nursing
NURS 520.description: Study of organizational behaviour, management methods and administrative processes in health care.

NURS 530.title: Advanced Practice in Nursing
NURS 530.description: Study of advanced practice nursing models, their development and implementation with a changing health care system.

NURS 531.title: Theoretical Foundations of Clinical Education
NURS 531.description: Theories of learning and their implications for the design of clinical learning experiences.

NURS 535.title: Design of Clinical Informatics Solutions
NURS 535.description: Fundamental theories, concepts, and processes in the fields of software design in healthcare. Restricted to students in the Graduate Certificate in Clinical Informatics program.

NURS 536.title: Planning and Implementation in Clinical Informatics
NURS 536.description: Introduction to and application of organisational considerations for planning and implementing clinical informatics solutions. Restricted to students in the Graduate Certificate in Clinical Informatics program.

NURS 537.title: Data and Databases for Clinical Informatics
NURS 537.description: Database design, interoperability and terminology standards, knowledge representation and management, computerized clinical decision support including artificial intelligence, artificial intelligence bias, machine learning, and information visualization. Introduction to and application of knowledge management strategies in clinical informatics. Restricted to students in the Graduate Certificate in Clinical Informatics program.

NURS 540.title: Educational Processes in Nursing
NURS 540.description: Study of the historical development, theoretical basis, practical knowledge, accountability of, and issues regarding curriculum process and teaching in nursing education or practice.

NURS 541.title: Clinical Nursing Education
NURS 541.description: Study of the theory and practice of clinical nursing education.

NURS 573.title: Nurse Practitioner Oncology I
NURS 573.description: Oncology care management of breast, lung, colorectal, gastrointestinal, and genitourinary cancers. Emphasis on integration of biomedical science, clinical assessment, case management, and evidence-based treatment strategies, including the use of immunotherapy. Students must achieve 80% or higher to pass. This course is restricted to students in the Graduate Certificate in Nurse Practitioner Oncology program. Pass/Fail.

NURS 574.title: Nurse Practitioner Oncology II
NURS 574.description: Oncology care management of gynecologic, head and neck, and hematologic malignancies. Principles and practice of radiation oncology, pain and symptom management, management of drug reactions, and recognition and treatment of oncological emergencies. Students must achieve 80% or higher to pass. This course is restricted to students in the Graduate Certificate in Nurse Practitioner Oncology program. Pass/Fail.

NURS 575.title: Nurse Practitioner Oncology III
NURS 575.description: Prepares Nurse Practitioners to deliver comprehensive oncology care, with a focus on sarcomas, skin cancers, and central nervous system malignancies. Emphasizes diagnosis, treatment, symptom management, survivorship, and culturally competent care. Integrates Indigenous knowledge and DEI principles to support equitable, patient-centered practice. Students must achieve 80% or higher to pass. This course is restricted to students in the Graduate Certificate in Nurse Practitioner Oncology program. Pass/Fail.

NURS 576.title: Topics in Social and Environmental Planning to Foster Health of Populations
NURS 576.description: Characteristics of social and built environments for their impact on the health of populations.

NURS 577.title: Graduate Practicum in Nursing
NURS 577.description: Restricted to students in the Master of Health Leadership and Policy. Pass/Fail.
